correctness.rationale: For any even r>=2, connected simply branched double cover C->E has genus 1+r/2. Its orbifold extension Gamma has H1(Gamma)=Z^2+ (Z/2)^(r-1). The covering character is surjective on the branch torsion and its kernel there is (Z/2)^(r-2); H2(Z/2;Z)=0 in the 5-term sequence identifies H1(C)_iota with ker[H1Gamma->Z/2], giving Z^2+T. Translation by a nonzero order-two elliptic point yields free diagonal action and S=(F×C)/Z2 diffeomorphic to S1×M_iota (mapping torus of the deck involution). Integral Wang gives H1(M)=Z^3+T, H2(M)=Z^3, H3(M)=Z; Kunneth gives H_*(S):Z,Z^4+T,Z^6+T,Z^4,Z, and integral universal coefficient gives torsion T in H^2(S),H^3(S). Published relative embedding lemma embeds S in P4×E (codim3), and integral blow-up cohomology gives H^k(X)=H^k(P4×E)+H^(k-2)(S)+H^(k-4)(S); hence T in k=4,5,6,7 each and nowhere else. Independent exact Betti-polynomial calculation yielded (1,2,3,6,9,10,9,6,3,2,1), Euler char0. This is an all-even-r topological proof, not extrapolation from r<=16 finite arithmetic checks.
